subjects.title: Promoting Road Awareness for Youth and Safety (PRAYAS)

units.title: Traffic Rules & Signs
units.topics: Video lessons (road signs, speed, pedestrian safety), Webinar: “Why Rules Save Lives” (Traffic Police official), Case studies (Pune accidents, PDF + discussion), Seminar + Quiz.

units.title: Licence & Legal Awareness
units.topics: Video lessons (Licence process, penalties, insurance, PUC), Mock RTO test (via LMS, interactive quiz), Webinar: “Legal rights & responsibilities of drivers” (RTO official), Seminar Q&A.

units.title: Helmets, Safety Gear & First Aid
units.topics: Demo videos (Helmet, ISI mark, seatbelts, reflective jackets), Seminar (hands-on demos in college), Practical mock drill (accident response, CPR intro), Webinar: “Golden Hour & First Aid Awareness” (doctor/NGO), Quiz & safety gear checklist.

units.title: Balancing, Vehicle Maintenance & Eco-Driving
units.topics: Video tutorials (daily checks, fuel efficiency, eco-driving), Practical balancing drills (two-wheeler, supervised), Seminar (four-wheeler maintenance basics), Webinar: “Smart Driving = Safe Driving”, Quiz.

units.title: Pollution Control & Green Mobility
units.topics: Video: PUC importance, horn & silencer issues, Seminar: Green Mobility (EV awareness, eco-driving), Webinar with MPCB expert, Activity: On-campus PUC & anti-honking drive, Quiz.

units.title: New–Age Driver Training
units.topics: Simulator-based training (or digital driving modules), Webinar: “EVs & Future of Mobility”, Telematics/navigation tools (app-based learning), Seminar Q&A, Quiz.

units.title: Driving Behaviour & Road Safety
units.topics: Video: behaviour risks (speeding, distraction, substance), Webinar: “Psychology of Safe Driving” (behavioural expert), Seminar: road rage, emotional control, respect on roads, Group discussion (student role plays), Final quiz & feedback.

notes: Co-Curricular Course can be conducted in any one semester (II / III / IV); listed under semester 2.
